original.sql:
SELECT chunk_lexical.content_hash, -bm25(chunk_lexical) AS score 
FROM chunk_lexical 
WHERE chunk_lexical.terms MATCH ? AND chunk_lexical.content_hash IN (SELECT blob_chunks.content_hash 
FROM blob_chunks JOIN blobs ON blobs.blob_name = blob_chunks.blob_name 
WHERE blobs.status = ? AND blob_chunks.blob_name IN (SELECT chain_members.blob_name 
FROM chain_members JOIN chains ON chains.chain_id = chain_members.chain_id 
WHERE chain_members.chain_id = ? AND chains.version = ?)) ORDER BY score DESC, chunk_lexical.content_hash
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
plan: SEARCH chain_members USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_chain_members_1 (chain_id=?)
SEARCH blob_chunks USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_blob_chunks_1 (blob_name=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
